name: SW-420 Seismic Motion / Normally Closed Vibration Sensor Module
sensor_element: SW-420 normally closed spring-contact vibration switch inside protective brass tube

electrical_specs.operating_voltage_range_v: 3.3V - 5.0V DC (3.3V typical for direct MCU interface)
electrical_specs.driving_ability_ma: > 15 mA (LM393 open-collector output with onboard pull-up resistor)
electrical_specs.sensing_principle: Spring vibrates and momentarily breaks contact when ground footsteps or seismic shocks exceed threshold

physical_pins.label: VCC
physical_pins.notes: Powered from 3.3V rail to ensure DO logic high does not exceed 3.3V.

physical_pins.label: DO
physical_pins.notes: Normally LOW when quiescent (closed circuit); pulses HIGH when mechanical vibration momentarily interrupts spring contact.

controls_and_features.name: SW-420 Sensor Tube
controls_and_features.desc: Encapsulated spring-rod contact switch sensitive to directional shockwaves.

controls_and_features.name: Sensitivity Potentiometer
controls_and_features.desc: 10k trimpot adjusting comparator reference voltage; tune to filter small rodent noise while triggering on megafauna footsteps (>3,000 kg).

controls_and_features.name: Power Indicator LED
controls_and_features.desc: Green LED lit when VCC rail is powered.

controls_and_features.name: Output Switch LED
controls_and_features.desc: Red LED illuminates when vibration triggers high output pulse.

role_in_prw_wild.purpose: Detects ground-coupled seismic shockwaves produced by elephant locomotion (typically 1-3 Hz footfall cadence).
role_in_prw_wild.strengths: Unaffected by ambient light, thermal fog, darkness, or vegetation density; low computational burden.
role_in_prw_wild.limitations: Attenuation through loose sand/humus limits radius to ~15-25m; non-directional on single node.
